in_arabic.name: زريقة

in_urdu.name: زریقہ

in_pashto.name: زریقه
in_pashto.long_meaning: زریقه نوم د عربي ريښې 'ز-ر-ق' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې 'نیلا رنګ' یا 'زرق' دی. دا نوم د ښایست او نیکۍ نښه ده. د افغان او پښتنو په دود کې، دا نوم د روحاني او ښایسته معنا سره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Zurayqa
in_english.meaning: Beautiful woman or one with a bright and clear complexion
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zurayqa originates from the Arabic root 'ز-ر-ق' (z-r-q), meaning 'to pour forth' or 'blue'. It signifies beauty, clarity, and purity. Historically, the name has been used in Islamic tradition to denote a woman with a radiant and lovely appearance. The Quran does not directly mention the name, but the root 'z-r-q' appears in various forms related to vision and perception. The name Zurayqa symbolizes spiritual illumination and physical beauty.
